title: Metazoan and apicomplexan biodiversity in different land uses across China
description: To investigate the association between apicomplexan and metazoan biodiversity, We used metabarcoding to investigate the biogeography of and links between Apicomplexa and soil metazoa in three human-dominated ecosystem types (farmlands, residential areas and parks) and more natural forests across subtropical, warm-temperate and mid-temperate climatic regions in China.
center: Institute of Urban Environment, Chinese Academy of Sciences
